item.title: Front matter schema
item.description:
The front matter of a statement is YAML written inside SQL comments, which means your editor highlights the SQL and leaves the part with all the keys in it entirely unassisted. A JSON schema fixes that: completion for every key, the description on hover, and a warning on a key that does not exist.

The schema is published at https://yosql.projects.metio.wtf/schema/frontmatter.json and generated from the same description of the settings that generates the configuration reference , so the two cannot drift.
